newsitem.title: USA: Block Financial site adds Reuters data.
newsitem.headline: Block Financial site adds Reuters data.

text.p: Block Financial Corp, a unit of H&R Block Inc, said Wednesday its "Conductor" online site will feature news, weather and stock quotes from Reality Online Inc, a subsidiary of Reuters Holdings Plc.

Within the next month, online users of Conductor will be able to research a company's stock symbol, request stock quotes for companies trading on Nasdaq, the New York Stock Exchange or the American Stock Exchange, and receive market quotes and commentaries from Reuters.
All market information will be current within a 20 minute margin, Block said.
Consumers also will be able to visit the Conductor site using Reuters Portfolio Tracker, a service that lets customers create up to 10 portfolios, each with up to 30 securities.
In the future, Reuters will supplement its Conductor offerings with mutual fund research, technical analysis, advice from experts and personalized news clipping services.
